relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: In the rat model of ION-CCI, TLR4 in the rat trigeminal ganglion regulates Nav1.3 through the TRAF6/NF-κB p65 pathway, and TLR4 antagonist alleviates neuropathic pain in ION-CCI rats.

relationships.subject: ION-CCI
relationships.evidence_quote: ION-CCI surgery decreased the mechanical pain threshold of rats and increased the expression of ATF3, TLR4, TRAF6, NF-κB p-p65 and Nav1.3, but there was no difference in NF-κB p65 expression.

key_findings: In ION-CCI rats, TLR4 in the trigeminal ganglion regulates Nav1.3 via TRAF6/NF-κB p65.
TLR4 antagonist, TRAF6 inhibitor and NF-κB inhibitor lowered Nav1.3 and raised mechanical threshold.
